definitions.explanation: An unspecified multiple, typically implying three to ten times as much. Used to express a large but vague multiplier.

examples.japanese: ⟦{値段|ねだん}→値段：00871_nedan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{数倍|すうばい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{上|あ}がった→上がる：00615_agaru⟧。
examples.english: The price rose several times over.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{機械|きかい}→機械：02366_kikai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{旧型|きゅうがた}→旧型：18276_kyuugata⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{数倍|すうばい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{速|はや}さ→速さ：28072_hayasa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{動|うご}く→動く：00904_ugoku⟧。
examples.english: This machine runs several times faster than the old model.

examples.japanese: ⟦{都心|としん}→都心：04072_toshin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦マンション→マンション：01035_manshon⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{郊外|こうがい}→郊外：01403_kougai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{数倍|すうばい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{値段|ねだん}→値段：00871_nedan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Apartments in the city center cost several times as much as those in the suburbs.

notes:
USAGE:
{数倍|すうばい} is a compound of ⟦{数|すう}→数：03360_suu⟧ (several) and ⟦{倍|ばい}→倍：01492_bai⟧ (times/fold). It is used when the exact multiplier is unknown or unimportant, conveying the idea of a significant increase.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- X⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{数倍|すうばい} (several times X)
- {数倍|すうばい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{増|ふ}える→増える：01183_fueru⟧ / ⟦{上|あ}がる→上がる：00615_agaru⟧ (to increase severalfold)
- {数倍|すうばい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ + noun (severalfold + noun)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{何倍|なんばい}→何倍：22969_nanbai⟧ (how many times — question form)
- ⟦{数十倍|すうじゅうばい}→数十倍：24586_suujuubai⟧ (tens of times — even larger multiple)
- {倍以上|ばいいじょう} (more than double)
